Seconds to install

Use the gateway directly, or add SDK headers when you need metadata.

JavaScript
npm install @forsig/sdk

import OpenAI from "openai";
import { forsigHeaders } from "@forsig/sdk";

const client = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.FORSIG_API_KEY,
  baseURL: "https://gateway.forsig.com/v1",
});

await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: "gpt-4o-mini",
  messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Analyze this ticket" }],
}, {
  headers: forsigHeaders({ externalUserId: "user_123" }),
});
Python
pip install forsig

from openai import OpenAI
from forsig import forsig_headers

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["FORSIG_API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://gateway.forsig.com/v1",
)

client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this ticket"}],
    extra_headers=forsig_headers(external_user_id="user_123"),
)

Private beta

Join the first builders protecting agent traffic.

Early access is for founders and developers building real AI agents, copilots, automations, and AI SaaS products.

Does Forsig replace my agent framework?

No. Forsig registers and controls external agents. Your agent remains in your app.

Do I have to use an SDK?

No. Any OpenAI-compatible client can use Forsig by changing the base URL and API key.

Does Forsig store prompts?

Not by default. The MVP stores metadata, token counts, cost, prompt hashes, and policy outcomes.
